rules: Use only these exact source byte spans and hashes; stop on any mismatch.
Remove balanced outer illustration wrappers including nested copyright notices; preserve all removed exact spans separately in any future derivative.
For Chapter I only, retain the literal original Chapter I. bytes from inside the wrapper; remove prefix and outer closing bracket separately. No invented heading.
Retain all other bytes exactly: CRLF, spelling, italics underscores, quotation punctuation and paragraph whitespace. No normalization or line dewrapping in this policy.
Never delete quoted narrative outside the balanced illustration wrapper or deduplicate caption quotations against prose.
Chapter documents remain whole chapter units, all one Austen work family across every edition and derivative.

Preserve original complete raw file and partition, PG license/trademark/frontmatter/preface and source/transcription credits as provenance; their exclusion from narrative input is not deletion from archives.
Do not alter existing discovery annotation evidence; corrected proposal spans supersede only for a future explicitly versioned derivative.

Before derivative acceptance, manually review all 155 proposed annotation spans (70 captions and 85 bare markers), compare whole chapters around every deletion, rehash and retokenize actual saved output, and run overlap/family split gates.
No generic clearance of modern transcription/editorial contributions or distribution territories follows from expired original-work terms.
